name: @earendil-works/tau-coding-agent
description: Tau coding agent CLI with OpenRouter model access and session management

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run generate-models && tsgo -p tsconfig.build.json && shx chmod +x dist/cli.js && bun run copy-assets
scripts.build:binary: bun run build && bun build --compile ./dist/bun/cli.js ./src/utils/image-resize-worker.ts --outfile ../../dist/tau && bun run copy-binary-assets
scripts.copy-assets: shx mkdir -p dist/modes/interactive/theme && shx cp src/modes/interactive/theme/*.json dist/modes/interactive/theme/ && shx mkdir -p dist/modes/interactive/assets && shx cp src/modes/interactive/assets/*.png dist/modes/interactive/assets/ && shx mkdir -p dist/core/prompts && shx cp src/core/prompts/*.md dist/core/prompts/
scripts.copy-binary-assets: shx cp package.json ../../dist/ && shx cp README.md ../../dist/ && shx cp CHANGELOG.md ../../dist/ && shx cp -r native ../../dist/ && shx mkdir -p ../../dist/theme && shx cp src/modes/interactive/theme/*.json ../../dist/theme/ && shx mkdir -p ../../dist/assets && shx cp src/modes/interactive/assets/*.png ../../dist/assets/ && shx cp -r docs ../../dist/ && shx cp -r examples ../../dist/ && (shx cp ../../node_modules/@silvia-odwyer/photon-node/photon_rs_bg.wasm ../../dist/ 2>/dev/null || shx cp ../../node_modules/.bun/@silvia-odwyer+photon-node@0.3.4/node_modules/@silvia-odwyer/photon-node/photon_rs_bg.wasm ../../dist/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'WARN: photon_rs_bg.wasm not found') && shx mkdir -p ../../dist/core/prompts && shx cp src/core/prompts/*.md ../../dist/core/prompts/ && shx cp ../ai-dash/bin/ai-dash ../../dist/ai-dash

author: Mario Zechner
